title: Nymphs in Golden Pond
description: A surreal painting depicts two translucent female figures with flowing hair emerging from a purple pond covered in lily pads. Golden sunlight rays pierce through trees in a lush green landscape, with their reflections and golden drips visible in the water.
prompt: A surreal scene of two ethereal female water spirits with long flowing hair rising from a purple pond filled with lily pads. Their translucent forms drip with golden liquid as they reflect in the water. Warm golden sunbeams cut through a lush green forest and trees surrounding the pond at golden hour, impressionistic digital painting style with rich colors and dreamy atmosphere.
